items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: What was Barney's real name? Was it Albany or what? Albany. Albany. Albany.

ctx.x: You remember if that was, I suppose that would be the album system, the same as Barney played.

Yeah. What was Barney's real name? Was it Albany or what? Albany. Albany. Albany. What is his middle name? Remember any middle name? Leon. Oh, yes. Who started calling him Barney? Did you call him that around home too? Yeah.
How did you pronounce it? Did you call it Barney? Or just Barney?
